about: What `devmap --json` writes on stdout for the commands DevCouncil's Go host (backend/go_orchestrator/dc/devmap) drives. Each entry names the fields a consumer may rely on and their JSON types; a producer may add fields, never remove or retype these. A command that fails without producing a report writes the `error_envelope` instead, which has no `check_ok`: a consumer tells the two apart by that field and must never decode an envelope as a report. Replayed against the live binary by TestTheLiveStdioContractReplay (dc/devmap/stdio_contract_test.go), which CI runs with devmap built from this tree. Stdout carries the data; stderr is prose and is not part of the contract.

integrate_report.exit: 0 when applied or current; non-zero under --check when check_ok is false, the report still printed first

remove_report.exit: 0 unless a document is refused; under --check non-zero while a server is still registered

error_envelope.command: any devmap --json command that fails before producing a report
